image_description: A close-up, eye-level view of a dilapidated prison cell interior or entrance. The scene features rough, textured stone walls on the left and right. A heavy, rusted metal gate with vertical bars and a diamond-pattern chain-link mesh dominates the center. A horizontal metal bar reinforces the bottom of the gate. Through the gate, a dimly lit corridor or adjacent cell is visible, with a small white sign bearing the number '13' attached to the mesh. The lighting is dramatic, casting strong shadows and highlighting the texture of the stone and rust.
